changelog.summary: This update introduces several platform-specific enhancements and general fixes. For Android users, the "Allow screenshot" option can now display an optional visual cue, and the app will react to system light/dark mode changes without recreating the screen. Support has also been added for marking copied values as sensitive on pre-Tiramisu devices. On desktop platforms, the application has been migrated to a native Compose tray. Finally, this release resolves an issue causing "en-US" to appear twice in the language selector and adds support for re-prompting on Custom field actions.

changelog.summary: This release introduces functional and user interface updates for Windows. The trust manager has been consolidated to combine the Windows-My, Windows-ROOT, and default certificate stores. On Windows, the main window title will now dynamically change to match the selected application theme. A bug has also been fixed where blank tags were incorrectly being saved with vault ciphers.

changelog.summary: This release includes several improvements to the password generator and fixes for certificate handling. You can now create longer passphrases of up to 20 words, and the generator will display a character count for both passphrases and usernames. We have also resolved issues with certificate stores on Windows and macOS for a more reliable experience.

changelog.summary: This update introduces a new feature allowing you to tap an application's URI to look it up in the Google Play, F-Droid, or Apple App stores, which now also fetches app icons. An issue on Android has been fixed where cancelling an autofill prompt could cause the service to stop working. For desktop users, the Windows and macOS apps now use the system's native certificate store for improved connectivity. This release also includes several minor performance and user interface enhancements.

This release focuses on internal housekeeping and packaging improvements to ensure a stable experience.
